notes: Lee Sims Photographs of Tenants and Owners in Opposition to Redevelopment (TOOR) (SFP 125) — the South of Market residential hotels photographed in 1970-71, weeks to months before the Yerba Buena clearances took them. Two cautions specific to this batch: its 500$a photographer's notes are roll-level, not per-record, so the address comes from the title alone; and its unnumbered half is the people of those hotels, so it is read under named-buildings-only with the personal-name redaction on raw.text.

coverage.remaining: None. The collection was read whole.
coverage.note: 253 records read; 60 give an exact street number; 154 give none; 39 were skipped as photographs of people. 36 findings over 23 distinct addresses; 11 resolved, 25 unresolved. Ten of the unresolved are buildings EAS no longer holds because they were demolished — the Milner, Panama, Mars, St. Regis and Imperial hotels on 4th Street, 789 Howard, 286 Second Street, 175 3rd Street, 115 Market and 252 6th Street. Those are the most valuable records in the collection and the one class the evidence bar keeps off a page.
